name: io.github.tonyyang0504/amazon-mcp
description: Amazon (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders. Every tool

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: LWA client identifier of your SP-API application (Developer Central / Solution Provider Portal > app > LWA credentials).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: LWA client secret of the same application.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LWA refresh token (Atzr|...) from self-authorising the app for your seller account (or from the seller's OAuth authorization); exchanged at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token for 1-hour access tokens sent as x-amz-access-token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_REGION
environmentVariables.description: SP-API endpoint region: na (Canada, US, Mexico, Brazil), eu (Europe, UK, India, Middle East, Turkey, South Africa) or fe (Japan, Australia, Singapore); calls go to https://sellingpartnerapi-<region>.amazon.com.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_SELLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Selling partner (merchant token) id used in the Listings Items path /listings/2021-08-01/items/{sellerId}/{sku} (Seller Central > Settings > Account Info > Merchant Token).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_MARKETPLACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Marketplace id the tools act on, e.g. ATVPDKIKX0DER (US) or A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK); see the SP-API Marketplace IDs page.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency of the marketplace's offers (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR); needed only when update_listing changes the price (purchasable_offer selector).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://sandbox.sellingpartnerapi-{region}.amazon.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
